proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Unlimited free requests (rate-limited to 200 requests per minute per IP).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts any URL into clean, LLM-ready Markdown text while automatically bypassing common anti-bot/Cloudflare protections.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate directly into 'agent_trendhunter' and 'agent_niche_gap' via GitHub Actions to safely scrape Etsy, Amazon, or Reddit trends without paying for proxy networks.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: High volume scraping may require adding a free Jina API key to increase rate limits, though basic usage requires no key at all.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free credits daily (resetting every 24 hours), enough for ~100 SDXL or 50 FLUX images.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides incredibly fast serverless APIs for advanced model architectures, including specialized ControlNet, SDXL, and IP-Adapter setups perfect for structured lines (coloring books).
proposals.would_integrate_where: Replace Pollinations in 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_kdp_cover' pipelines to generate high-resolution, perfectly-framed vector-style illustrations.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Free tier API keys may occasionally experience queue delays during peak hours.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Unlimited free access to multiple state-of-the-art open models (like Llama 3 8B, Mistral 7B, Phi-3) marked as $0.00/M tokens.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Aggregates hundreds of LLMs into a single OpenAI-compatible API format, enabling seamless fallback to zero-cost models if Gemini hits quota limits.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Used in the 'agent_orchestrator' multi-model fallback routine to ensure the perpetual brains never stall when Gemini APIs rate-limit or fail.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Free models can sometimes suffer from higher latency during periods of extreme global demand.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: No monthly fee. Zero cost to host unlimited digital files. Only takes a 5% + $0.50 transaction fee on successful sales.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Acts as a Merchant of Record, meaning they completely handle global sales tax and EU VAT compliance automatically. Essential for a solo founder based in France.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Host and distribute digital game asset packs, parametric STL files, and PDF coloring book packs directly, bypassing Etsy listing fees.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Payouts require reaching a minimum threshold ($10) and are processed on a weekly schedule.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $1.80 free sign-up credit. FLUX.1-schnell costs only $0.0008 per image, translating to ~2,250 free high-quality images.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Offers the absolute lowest market pricing for FLUX.1-schnell and SDXL models with a fully compatible OpenAI/Diffusers API wrapper.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Main image production engine in 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' and 'produce_tumbler_wraps' pipelines to get professional-grade, commercial-use graphics.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Once the initial $1.80 credit is exhausted, requires a credit card to top up (though $5 will buy over 6,000 additional images).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free with no API keys, no registration, and highly relaxed rate limits.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Programmatic search engine scraping directly through Python. Allows retrieving live search results, news, and images directly within terminal environments.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into 'agent_trend_explosion' and 'agent_opportunity_hunter' to cross-reference hot keywords with actual live search popularity directly from Termux or GitHub Actions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Aggressive, concurrent multi-threading from the same GitHub Actions IP block can trigger temporary rate limits (HTTP 429).
